name: Sbu Words

replaces.name: Vocabulary - Learn words daily
replaces.price_model: freemium, Vocabulary Premium auto-renewing subscription after a 3-day trial

one_thing: Sbu Words shows you one new word a day, with a checked definition, on your Lock Screen.

features.name: Word of the day
features.description: One word per day (Italian or English, the user's choice) with part of speech, short definition, one example, and the date. The single figure of the screen is the word.
features.reason: The product; Vocabulary's free tier shows it but buries it under upsells.

features.name: Lock and Home Screen widgets
features.description: WidgetKit accessory (Lock Screen) and small/medium Home Screen widgets showing today's word; same word and same settings on every widget, refreshed at local midnight.
features.reason: Widget customisation is paywalled in Vocabulary and is why most users install it.

features.name: Saved words
features.description: Save a word with one tap; list with search; works with no purchase.
features.reason: Viewing saved words is paywalled in Vocabulary (2 reviews call it dishonest).

features.name: Review
features.description: Short review of saved words: see the word, recall, reveal, mark 'La sapevo' / 'Non ancora'; spaced intervals (1, 3, 7, 21 days) as a pure, tested scheduler. No timed games, no streaks.
features.reason: Practice games are the paywalled core of Premium; review of saved words also asked in 1 review.

features.name: Level and topics
features.description: Level and topic choice when the user wants it (default works without setup).

features.name: Pace you choose
features.description: Words per period: 1 a day (default), 3 a week, 1 a week. Notifications off by default; if on, at most one local notification per new word, at the chosen time. Never promotional.
features.reason: Notification spam, pop-ups, no way to slow down: 9 reviews.

features.name: Definitions you can trust
features.description: Definitions only from the bundled, licence-cleared word list (see dependencies), reviewed before shipping; 'Apri nel dizionario' opens the iOS system dictionary (UIReferenceLibraryViewController) for the full entry. No generated definitions.
features.reason: Wrong definitions, wrong synonyms, invented words: 11 reviews; distrust of AI content: 5.

features.name: Difficulty by frequency
features.description: Level is a frequency band from a corpus rank (very common to rare) with a 5-step slider, not three labels; words above the user's band are skipped.
features.reason: Too easy or uselessly obscure, no fine control: 12 reviews.

features.name: Start without setup
features.description: First launch shows today's word immediately. Level and topics are optional, in settings. No quiz, no questionnaire.
features.reason: Long setup quiz then paywall: 8 reviews.

features.name: Clean list
features.description: Vulgar, sexual and slur entries excluded at build time; neologism/fictional sources (e.g. invented-word books) excluded; topic toggles to hide categories.
features.reason: Sexual terms on the Lock Screen, invented words: 4 reviews.

features.name: No repeats, skip known
features.description: A word is never shown twice unless saved for review; 'La so già' replaces it with the next word and lowers its weight.
features.reason: Words repeat, cannot skip known ones: 5 reviews.

features.name: Pronunciation
features.description: AVSpeechSynthesizer with the system voice for the word's language, user-selectable voice; IPA text from the data where licensed. Plays even with the ring switch on silent via audio session category, shows a clear message if volume is zero.
features.reason: Wrong pronunciation, voice locked, button silent: 5 reviews.

features.name: Widget that just works
features.description: Widget reads a shared App Group snapshot; no feature removed if the user never opens the app.
features.reason: Widget inconsistent, not working, revoked: 4 reviews.

features.name: Italian and English words
features.description: Italian UI and an Italian word list as well as English; when both lists cover the same meaning, show the other language's word.
features.reason: Cannot use in Italian, wants foreign words with meaning in own language: 3 reviews.

features.name: Etymology
features.description: One-line origin of the word, only if a licence-compatible source exists.
features.reason: Asked in 1 review; Wiktionary has it but is CC BY-SA (conflict).

features.name: Extra example sentence (on device)
features.description: On iOS 26 with Apple Intelligence available, an optional second example generated by Foundation Models, labelled 'Esempio generato', off by default. Fallback on iOS 17-25 or unsupported devices: the feature is hidden.
features.reason: Nice to have; reviews punish AI content, so never for definitions.

data_model.storage: Dictionary: read-only SQLite in the bundle (libsqlite3), built offline by a repo tool from licence-cleared sources, about 3000 entries per language. User state: SwiftData in the App Group container, read by the widget through a small snapshot of today's word. Optional iCloud sync per ADR-0008, off by default.

monetization.model: Free download with Vocabulary Premium auto-renewing subscription (weekly/monthly/yearly) after a 3-day trial
monetization.price: Not in the lookup; reviews cite $3.99/month, $35.99-$64.94 per year, four annual tiers between $10 and $60
monetization.notes: The paywall appears after a long setup quiz (8 reviews); the promised pre-renewal reminder does not arrive (20 reviews on trial charges). Marketing pushed through notifications and Live Activities.

dependencies.name: Princeton WordNet 3.0/3.1
dependencies.licence: WordNet 3.0 licence (Princeton University; permissive, BSD-like, attribution and copyright notice required)
dependencies.conflict: Not MIT or Apache. Permissive and compatible in practice, but the user's rule is MIT/Apache only: needs an explicit decision. Data is from 2006-2011 and its glosses are dated and terse, which feeds the 'wrong definition' pain.
dependencies.alternative: Open English WordNet (2024 edition, CC BY 4.0, maintained fork of WordNet) — also not MIT/Apache, attribution only; or the self-curated list below.

dependencies.name: Wiktionary (Italian)
dependencies.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (and GFDL), share-alike with attribution to contributors
dependencies.conflict: Strong conflict: share-alike means the derived word database must itself be distributed under CC BY-SA with attribution, which the MIT/Apache-only rule excludes. Do not import.
dependencies.alternative: Italian wordnet linked through Open Multilingual Wordnet (ItalWordNet ODC-BY 1.0 or MultiWordNet-IT CC BY 3.0, licences to verify) — attribution, not share-alike, still not MIT/Apache; or the self-curated list.

dependencies.name: Recommended: self-curated list
dependencies.use: About 3000 words per language chosen by frequency band, short glosses and examples written and reviewed in-house; full entry via the iOS system dictionary (UIReferenceLibraryViewController)
dependencies.conflict: None. Cost: curation effort not included in the 5-day estimate (about 2-3 extra days per language, or ship with a smaller list).
dependencies.alternative: If a dataset is accepted, Open English WordNet (CC BY 4.0) for English with attribution in Impostazioni → Licenze.

review_risks.risk: Word-of-the-day apps are crowded and close to the 'well established' categories; Apple asks for a meaningfully different experience.
review_risks.mitigation: State the difference: no subscription, bilingual Italian/English list, definitions reviewed, pace control, Review without games. Submit alone, not with a lot.

review_risks.risk: Vocabulary's look (big word on a themed photo background, vertical swipe feed, onboarding quiz) is distinctive.
review_risks.mitigation: Paper surface, one word per day (no infinite feed), no themes, no onboarding; never name Vocabulary in metadata.

review_risks.risk: Shipping a dictionary derived from CC BY-SA or attribution-only data without the required notices, or Wiktionary content under the wrong licence.
review_risks.mitigation: Use only cleared data (dependencies), attribution in Impostazioni → Licenze, build tool records source and licence per entry.

review_risks.risk: Notifications used for engagement or marketing (the original's pain).
review_risks.mitigation: Local notifications only, off by default, one per new word, asked at the toggle.

review_risks.risk: Shared SbuKit and naming after the 14/10 lot rejection.
review_risks.mitigation: Review note 'How it differs from the other Sbu apps'; no other Sbu app overlaps (education, words).

review_risks.rule: 5.1.1 privacy and License Agreement 3.3.8(I) Foundation Models
review_risks.risk: Generated content presented as fact; data collection claims.
review_risks.mitigation: Foundation Models only for an optional, labelled example on iOS 26, off by default; Data Not Collected.
